definitions.explanation: A state of peace and order in society or in one's life. A formal, literary word often used in legal and official contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{安寧|あんねい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧。
examples.english: To protect the peace of society.

examples.japanese: {安寧|あんねい}⟦{秩序|ちつじょ}→秩序：10591_chitsujo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{脅|おびや}かす→脅かす：13942_obiyakasu⟧⟦{行為|こうい}→行為：10021_koui⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{許|ゆる}されない→許す：02325_yurusu⟧。
examples.english: Acts that threaten public order are not tolerated.

examples.japanese: ⟦{国民|こくみん}→国民：02757_kokumin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{安寧|あんねい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{幸福|こうふく}→幸福：02750_koufuku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{尽|つ}くす→尽くす：02077_tsukusu⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{誓|ちか}います→誓う：00030_chikau⟧。
examples.english: I pledge to work for the peace and happiness of the people.

notes:
{安寧|あんねい} combines {安|あん} (peace, safety) and {寧|ねい} (calm, tranquil). It is a formal, literary word.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {安寧|あんねい}⟦{秩序|ちつじょ}→秩序：10591_chitsujo⟧ (peace and order — a legal set phrase)
- ⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{安寧|あんねい} (social peace)
- {安寧|あんねい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{脅|おびや}かす→脅かす：13942_obiyakasu⟧ (to threaten the peace)
- {安寧|あんねい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧ (to protect the peace)

USAGE:
This is a formal word primarily found in legal texts, political speeches, and literary writing. In everyday conversation, ⟦{平和|へいわ}→平和：01507_heiwa⟧ (peace) or ⟦{安心|あんしん}→安心：01288_anshin⟧ (relief, peace of mind) would be used instead.
